desc.en: A screenshot API based on Aws Lambda and Chrome. Handles full page, captures timing, and viewport dimensions.
desc.zh: 基于 AWS Lambda 和 Chrome 的截图 API。支持整页截图、定时捕获和视口尺寸设置。

desc.en: It turns any website into data such as metatags normalization, beauty link previews, scraping capabilities, or screenshots as a service. 50 requests/day every day free.
desc.zh: 它可将任何网站转化为数据，例如元标签规范化、美观的链接预览、抓取能力，或作为服务提供的截图。每天 50 次请求，天天免费。

desc.en: Browser automation and page rendering. Free Tier offers up to 500 pages/day. Free Tier since 2017.
desc.zh: 浏览器自动化和页面渲染。免费套餐每天最多 500 页。自 2017 年起提供免费套餐。

desc.en: UK-based screenshot, PDF, image, QR code and clip rendering API with reusable templates and signed URLs. 250 free renders a month with no payment details needed to get started.
desc.zh: 总部位于英国的截图、PDF、图像、二维码和剪辑渲染 API，提供可复用模板和签名 URL。每月 250 次免费渲染，开始使用无需付款信息。

desc.en: 300 free screenshots / month. Take screenshots from any url. Fast, free & scalable.
desc.zh: 每月 300 张免费截图。可从任何 URL 截图。快速、免费且可扩展。

desc.en: Capture highly customizable snapshots of any website. Free 100 snapshots/month
desc.zh: 捕获高度可定制的任何网站快照。每月 100 张快照免费

desc.en: Capture 100 snapshots/month, png, gif and jpg, including full-length captures, not only home page
desc.zh: 每月捕获 100 张快照，支持 png、gif 和 jpg，包括全长捕获，不仅仅是首页

desc.en: Screenshot API for developers. Clean, production-ready screenshots from any URL in one request. Free plan includes 200 screenshots per month, forever.
desc.zh: 面向开发者的截图 API。一次请求即可从任何 URL 获得干净、可用于生产环境的截图。免费套餐包含每月 200 张截图，永久有效。

desc.en: Screenshot and Open Graph image API built for static sites. Free tier includes 100 renders/month, no card required. cached renders are free.
desc.zh: 为静态站点构建的截图和 Open Graph 图像 API。免费套餐包含每月 100 次渲染，无需信用卡。缓存渲染免费。

desc.en: Screenshot, video recording, PDF generation, and web data extraction API. Free plan includes 200 screenshots/month.
desc.zh: 截图、视频录制、PDF 生成和网页数据提取 API。免费套餐包含每月 200 张截图。

desc.en: API for generating thumbnails of websites. Free 1,000 requests/month.
desc.zh: 用于生成网站缩略图的 API。每月 1,000 次请求免费。
